papers.abstract: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.

analysis.key_results: 局部闭环评估中，视觉掩码使平均场景得分从0.479提高至0.517，结合AEB后进一步提高至0.599，有责碰撞场景数从34.0降至11.0。
analysis.limitations: 视觉掩码的总体开环误差与基线相当，仅在左转错误上有所减少；配对差值的95%置信区间包含零，符号检验p值为0.21，统计显著性不强。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GatedVLA策略，通过软视觉掩码增强跨注意力，并集成规则式自动紧急制动模块，在闭环评估中显著提升性能。
analysis.method: 驾驶预训练的Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B视觉语言模型与逐层流匹配动作专家输出2.5秒加速度和曲率控制，并使用软视觉掩码应用于专家的跨注意力；部署时加入基于规则的自动紧急制动模块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本报告介绍了一种将驾驶预训练视觉语言模型与流匹配动作专家相结合的视觉语言动作策略，用于自动驾驶闭环控制。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language model (VLM) inference without altering the output distribution, yet two factors limit its gains. Existing drafters either lack the image evidence required for visually grounded tokens or pay to condition on every visual token, although a short draft block typically depends on only a few image regions. Moreover, the value of verifying additional candidates varies with GPU load, so no fixed verification structure is efficient across serving conditions. We present Uni-LaSpec, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework that addresses both factors. To improve draft quality, Uni-LaSpec reuses the verifier's own attention: the query retained from the preceding verification ranks the cached, int8-quantized visual keys, and a cross-layer vote selects a few visual tokens that the drafter fuses through gated cross-attention. Acceptance-aware training further weights each draft position by its contribution to the accepted prefix. To allocate verification, a marginal-cost criterion selects the structure per request and per round: draft trees exploit idle verifier capacity under light load, whereas a dynamic head truncates linear drafts under heavy load. Across six VLMs from three model families and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, selecting eight visual tokens retains at least 98.6% of the acceptance obtained from the full image at sub-millisecond selection cost. With greedy decoding at concurrency one, Uni-LaSpec achieves up to 5.11x text and 3.24x multimodal throughput over autoregressive decoding. Across six load levels and three GPU types, it outperforms autoregressive decoding in every setting and matches or exceeds the best fixed verification strategy in 123 of 144 settings; under bursty arrivals, it reduces mean end-to-end latency by 47.6% relative to linear verification.

analysis.key_results: 在六个 VLM、17 个基准上，选择八个视觉 token 在亚毫秒选择成本下保留至少 98.6% 的接受度；贪心解码并发为 1 时，文本吞吐量最高加速 5.11 倍，多模态吞吐量最高加速 3.24 倍；在六种负载水平和三种 GPU 类型下均优于自回归解码，在 144 种设置中的 123 种匹配或超过最佳固定验证策略；突发到达下平均端到端延迟降低 47.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Uni-LaSpec 框架，通过复用验证器注意力选择少量关键视觉 token 以提升草稿质量，并根据 GPU 负载动态调整验证结构，实现负载自适应的推测解码。
analysis.method: 复用验证器注意力中的查询对缓存的 int8 量化视觉键进行排序，通过跨层投票选择少量视觉 token 并通过门控交叉注意力融合；使用接受感知训练按草稿位置加权；根据边际成本标准在每个请求和每轮中动态选择验证结构（草稿树或截断线性草稿）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 Uni-LaSpec，一个针对视觉语言模型的自适应推测解码框架，通过复用验证器注意力选择关键视觉 token 并动态分配验证结构，在不改变输出分布的前提下加速推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视觉语言模型的推测解码效率优化，不直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM。但其提出的视觉 token 选择机制和负载自适应验证策略可作为通用高效推理技术，对 VLA 或机器人世界模型中的视觉编码器和自回归解码组件具有潜在的方法学借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Robots manipulating in cluttered spaces must often plan from partial views where foreground objects occlude the target, surrounding geometry, and usable free space. Reactive policies often miss these hidden constraints, while exhaustive search becomes computationally prohibitive in dense clutter. We present SCOUT, an occlusion-aware planning framework that bridges high-level deliberation with grounded physical rollouts. SCOUT leverages an object-centric scene representation to reconstruct hidden geometry and derive a relational planning state capturing blocker hierarchies and accessibility corridors. To navigate the vast action space in clutter, an LLM proposes structured action candidates which are then rigorously evaluated via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) using a learned action-conditioned world model. Evaluations on 'Reveal' and 'Placement' tasks show that SCOUT outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, embodied agents, and 3D world models, with significant gains in long-horizon tasks requiring reasoning over occluded geometry. We further validate the framework's robustness through real-world robotic manipulation in a cluttered shelf environment.

analysis.key_results: 在“Reveal”和“Placement”任务上，SCOUT优于VLA策略、具身智能体及3D世界模型，尤其在需要推理遮挡几何的长程任务中提升显著；在真实杂乱货架环境中验证了框架的鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SCOUT框架，通过对象中心场景表示重建隐藏几何并推导关系规划状态，LLM生成结构化动作候选，MCTS结合学习到的动作条件世界模型进行严格评估，有效规划在遮挡下的机器人操作。
analysis.method: 使用对象中心场景表示重建被遮挡的几何结构，推导包含阻挡层次和可达走廊的关系规划状态；通过LLM提出结构化动作候选，并利用学习到的动作条件世界模型进行蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）来评估和选择动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个遮挡感知的机器人操作规划框架SCOUT，使用对象中心场景表示和LLM提出的动作候选，通过学到的动作条件世界模型进行MCTS推演，以处理部分观测下的复杂杂乱环境操作。

papers.abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.

analysis.key_results: 在两个模型家族和六个数据集上，协议显示有帮助的策略遵循任务家族；模型通常遵循自身感知，但在与常见先验矛盾的图像上失败，先定位可修复该失败；按测量阶段分配计算接近最佳均匀策略且成本更低，并优于随机分配。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出See, Think, Use协议，将视觉语言模型答案追溯到感知、推理或感知使用阶段，并据此指导测试时计算分配。
analysis.method: 通过定位探针（要求框出每个实例）和文本替换探针（根据描述回答）来分别衡量感知和推理，使用反事实图像对衡量感知使用率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种无需访问模型权重的协议，通过两个额外问题诊断视觉语言模型在感知、推理与使用感知三个阶段的失败。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于视觉语言模型的诊断与评估，不直接针对机器人动作预测或世界模型，但其方法学对VLA中感知与推理模块的故障诊断可能具有借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Private fine-tuning of large language models increasingly pairs DP-SGD with low-rank adapters on frozen, quantized backbones, and every such stack inherits one unstated premise: frozen layers keep each record's clipped gradient a function of that record alone. We show that LLM.int8 breaks this premise. It routes outlier activation columns to a higher-precision path using a union over the whole batch, so one record decides how every other record's activations are computed, even though the weights are frozen and the quantization scales are per row. We bound the resulting sensitivity inflation, state a record-isolation contract that restores the standard bound, and define record-owned precision dispatch that meets it with the same GEMMs as batched LLM.int8, so isolation needs no extra arithmetic. We then audit the native CUDA stack (bitsandbytes, PEFT, Opacus) against four matched controls. A constructed LoRA-Opacus witness reaches $15.0\times$ the add/remove bound. On pretrained OPT-125M with natural text, other records alter 20% of record-layer precision splits at batch size 16. An exploratory re-clipping analysis finds 10 of 64 candidate neighbors above the bound once every gradient is clipped; the top pair, revalidated natively, reaches $1.065C$ while every control stays within $C$, and forcing one layer's outlier mask removes the excess. A two-million-draw audit of the released adapters yields $\varepsilon$ lower bounds ($3.25$ at $\delta=10^{-5}$) below the advertised guarantee ($4.38$). Resolving an excess this small at the release level would take about 200 times more draws, whereas checking the sensitivity contract directly exposes it in a few native runs, which makes contract checking the practical audit for private quantized training.

analysis.key_results: 构造的 LoRA-Opacus 见证达到 15.0 倍添加/删除界；批量大小 16 时其他记录改变 20% 的记录层精度拆分；重裁剪分析发现 10/64 候选邻居超过界；两百万次抽样审计得到 ε 下界为 3.25（δ=10^-5），低于广告保证的 4.38。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了 LLM.int8 的批量并集路由在私有量化微调中导致跨记录敏感性膨胀，提出了记录隔离契约和记录拥有精度调度，并展示了无需额外算术的审计方法。
analysis.method: 对 LLM.int8 的离群激活列路由机制进行敏感性分析和隐私审计，通过构造 LoRA-Opacus 见证、在 OPT-125M 上验证、重裁剪分析和两百万次抽样审计量化影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文揭示了在私有量化微调中，LLM.int8 的跨记录精度路由破坏了 DP-SGD 的记录隔离假设，导致敏感性膨胀，并提出记录拥有精度调度来恢复标准界。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文研究量化模型的高效微调与差分隐私结合，未直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM，但量化与高效微调是机器人模型部署的重要相关技术，可为在机器人策略中安全使用量化微调提供依据。

papers.abstract: Agentic robots combine a vision-language brain, a tool-using harness, and a vision-language-action (VLA) policy. Serving a fleet of these agents introduces two coupled resource constraints: the brain repeatedly revisits long, growing key-value (KV) cache states, while the VLA executes action chunks under tight control deadlines. We characterize 80 LIBERO-PRO episodes generated by GPT-6-Astra, RPent, and pi0.5 (1,862 brain turns and 1,582 VLA inference chunks), profile both layers on H800 graphics processing units (GPUs), and replay the resulting agent programs on a vLLM serving engine. Brain contexts reach 215k tokens; the median Astra request takes 7.78 s, while the intervening environment-step gap is only 1.0 s. Under a 0.25 s action-chunk deadline, one VLA GPU meets the 1% starvation target for one robot; under a 1.0 s deadline, its measured capacity reaches at least 32. In sustained brain replay, increasing concurrency from 20 to 32 robots reduces throughput from about 2.4 to 0.6 requests/s as repetitive prefill displaces generation. A static active-episode cap restores 2.24-2.25 requests/s and raises completed trace-program throughput from 1.30 to 5.00-5.55 episodes/min. Our measurements expose the workload-dependent shift between action deadlines and brain KV residency, and establish practical principles for capacity planning and admission in sustained agentic robot fleets.

analysis.key_results: 脑上下文达到215k tokens；Astra请求中位耗时7.78s而环境步间隔仅1.0s；在0.25s动作块截止期下单个VLA GPU满足1%饥饿目标仅支持1台机器人，1.0s截止期下容量至少32；持续脑回放中并发从20升至32时吞吐从约2.4降至0.6请求/s，静态活跃回合上限恢复至2.24-2.25请求/s并将完成轨迹吞吐从1.30提升至5.00-5.55回合/分钟。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, yet deployed robots waste time in two ways that are independent of model capability: they halt while the next chunk is inferred, and they move at the speed of slow, cautious demonstrations. Existing remedies remove one loss each, and stacking them fails, because asynchrony and speed-up each change the correspondence between planned progress and executed motion. We present Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS), a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking policies built on one principle: the robot's motion is a time reparameterization of a reference path, and the path changes only in response to new observations. A path layer decodes every replan deterministically in one step and enters it at the progress consumed during inference. A time layer sums the planned increments, keeps the arm at 1x while the gripper moves, and caps the rate by the actuator's linear range and by chunk feasibility under latency. We show that misaligned entry and stochastic sampling add a bias and a variance to the continuation error, and derive a break-even success rate that states when speeding up pays off. On LIBERO with two frozen VLAs under injected inference latency, PTS raises task throughput over the strongest deployable baseline by 33% for pi0.5 and 104% for SmolVLA while matching or improving the success rate, is best on all six model-suite combinations, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution. Against asynchronous 1x execution with the same one-step decoder, the time layer alone adds 28% and 38%. On LIBERO-Dynamic it improves on stop-and-wait execution by 38% and is comparable to asynchronous 1x execution.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上使用两个冻结VLA模型，PTS将任务吞吐量提升33%（pi0.5）和104%（SmolVLA），成功率匹配或提高；在LIBERO-Dynamic上比停止等待执行提高38%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS)，一种免训练执行层，用于在推理延迟下加速冻结的VLA模型的动作块执行，提高任务吞吐量而不降低成功率。

papers.abstract: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.

papers.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) routinely use inference-time visual-token compression to prune hundreds of patch tokens down to a compact budget. Existing LVLM backdoors fire whenever a triggered image appears, whereas prior deployment-triggered attacks activate only when model weights are quantized or pruned. However, conventional LVLM backdoors exhibit nearly 100% attack success rate (ASR) under full-token inference, immediately exposing compromised checkpoints during pre-deployment auditing. We reveal context stripping: surrounding clean visual tokens suppress an embedded trigger at full length, whereas token pruning strips this context away and activates the backdoor. Motivated by this finding, we propose StripWake, a projector-only backdoor that remains dormant under full-token auditing yet activates across unseen compressors. Specifically, StripWake pairs clean-supervised full-token views with target-supervised randomized compressed views, and aligns early visual attention with a frozen benign teacher to preserve clean utility. On LLaVA-1.5-7B across nine unseen compressors, StripWake stays dormant at 0.4% full-token ASR yet achieves 94.0%-99.7% compressed ASR across five primary compressors without CIDEr loss.

papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $\pi_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $\pi_{0.5}$.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo上平均成功率达12.67%，在所评估的基于π0.5的方法中最高；与最新大规模预训练的VLA和WAM基础模型相当；在RoboTwin 2.0上性能提升；在四个真实世界双手操作任务上平均成功率比π0.5提高20.8个百分点。

papers.abstract: Garment flattening and folding require robots to identify garment structure during manipulation and adapt their actions as the cloth deforms. We present ClothDojo, a simulation platform that generates adaptive manipulation trajectories at scale across diverse garments and initial states and evaluates policies in closed loop. ClothDojo encodes each garment's canonical mesh coordinates as an NOCS texture, providing canonical surface-position cues through the visual interface of a pretrained vision-language-action model. We fine-tune the model on human demonstrations and corrections to obtain a data-generation policy. The policy autonomously generates simulated manipulation trajectories, and we retain rollouts that satisfy task-specific success criteria. Each retained trajectory is re-rendered under a randomly sampled appearance to provide RGB observations for downstream policies that do not receive NOCS. Across both tasks, the policy produces nearly 8,000 successful trajectories over hundreds of garments. RGB policies trained on these generated trajectories outperform those trained directly on the original human demonstrations and corrections across all evaluated garment splits and appearance settings. Evaluations across multiple policy models show that overall performance and appearance robustness vary across models and tasks, while generalization to unseen garments remains a common challenge.

analysis.limitations: 评估显示不同策略模型在总体性能和外观鲁棒性上表现不一，且对未见衣物的泛化仍是共同挑战。

papers.abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) models are computationally expensive to train but distributed as easily copied parameter files. Existing watermarks protect these assets by fine-tuning the scene against a neural decoder to extract bit strings from rendered video, a heavy process vulnerable to the temporal dynamics of dynamic scenes. However, if the threat model targets the redistributed file itself, verification can be vastly simplified. Because the canonical Spherical-Harmonic (SH) coefficients of 4DGS are time- and view-invariant, parameter-space perturbations can be recovered via deterministic arithmetic. We propose **SHield**, the first non-blind, decoder-free watermarking approach that natively embeds full-resolution RGB images into 4DGS files. SHield tiles a zero-mean payload across the SH coefficients of a key-selected Gaussian subset, applying a brief anchored optimization to preserve visual fidelity. To verify ownership, it geometrically re-associates the key using canonical Gaussian centres to survive file tampering and recovers the payload in closed form. Across 30 scenes (D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, DyNeRF), SHield guarantees near-perfect payload recovery (Pearson $r \geq 0.991$) on all 150 tested models with a mean rendering penalty of $\leq 0.13$~dB. Held-out evaluation yields perfect detection on 400 true trials and zero false positives across $1{,}600$ wrong-subset null trials. We also strictly bound the method's robustness: SHield survives INT8 quantization and $30\%$ opacity pruning for the image payload, and on aggressive SH-degree-1 truncation bit payloads are still decodable.

analysis.key_results: 在30个场景150个模型上，Pearson相关系数不低于0.991，渲染损失不超过0.13 dB；在400次真实试验和1600次错误子集零试验中实现完美检测；能抵抗INT8量化、30%不透明度剪枝和激进SH度截断。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies. On RoboDojo, a large planning-execution gap separates high-level task decisions from physical execution: removing arm execution raises GPT-6 Astra's success rate from 22.5% under the reference control interface to 76.2%. We present Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness that closes 68.3% of this gap in zero-shot manipulation without target-task trials or resets. In Auriga, the model makes all task decisions over an explicit task belief and acts through either direct tool calls or synthesized multi-step Python programs, while the harness supplies calibrated 3D measurements, finger-referenced dual-arm control, and a single admission gateway to the robot. Before motion, the model inspects a visual trajectory preview while simulation is paused; during execution, the harness checks declared stage tolerances and grasp bounds, stopping the robot on divergence and returning the measured discrepancy for in-place recovery. Developed across 13 cross-task capability iterations and frozen for evaluation, Auriga ranks first on the RoboDojo leaderboard with a 57.7% success rate (64.0 Score), more than doubling the reference harness on the same model, and remains first under scene randomization while learned policies drop by up to 33.9%. On RoboCasa365, the same frozen harness reaches a 73.2% success rate, outperforming VLA-assisted agents by up to 23.1% on composite tasks. papers.abstract: When a World Action Model fails at control, is the bottleneck proposal generation or trajectory scoring? We introduce pico-WAM, a compact model with supplied physical state for tracing policy-dynamics interactions. Using 206 Push-T demonstrations and 15 training seeds, we compare data regimes and search configurations. Counterfactual branch training improves short-horizon cost ranking and enlarges the coverage advantage of policy-restarted over warm-started search by 4.8 percentage points; restart wins under both data regimes. Replacing learned trajectory scores with simulator costs improves coverage by 12.2 points while retaining learned proposals. Substituting simulator states in proposal generation alone shows no detected gain. Component diagnostics and a separate door-opening study show why better ranking need not yield better control or outperform imitation. These controlled interventions identify scoring as an effective improvement target in the tested setting and provide a reproducible protocol for diagnosing compact world models.

papers.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain KV-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. We present Jet-QSparse, a training-free method that combines compact NVFP4 cache storage with native FP4 query-key computation on Blackwell tensor cores. A dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse FP16 value aggregation with FP32 accumulation, preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. Calibrated key centering and at most two BF16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error; FP8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from BF16 activations. Across four hybrid LLMs, a budget of 128 blocks per KV head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks, although some smaller budgets incur losses. With 64 blocks, Qwen3.8-27B achieves a $1.94\times$ end-to-end decode speedup over dense BF16 at 128K context and batch size 16 on one GB300, and the measured Qwen KV pools provide $2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16's token capacity.

analysis.limitations: 某些较小预算下会出现损失。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Jet-QSparse，一种训练无关方法，结合紧凑NVFP4缓存存储与原生FP4查询键计算，加速智能体LLM解码。
analysis.method: 密集扫描评分全部键历史，选择128令牌块进行稀疏FP16值聚合与FP32累加；校准键中心化，每序列每层最多两个BF16页；FP8预填使用临时竞技场，持久缓存直接从BF16激活打包。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models re-encode the full observation through a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) at every control step, even though scene semantics evolve at roughly 1 Hz while reactive control requires 20-50 Hz. We present a VLA that decouples the two: a VLM runs as a low-frequency semantic anchor whose cached context is reused across control steps, while a flow-matching action expert operates at high frequency, consuming the cached semantics with a fresh, low-latency visual stream from a compact encoder pretrained on robot video with masked reconstruction, optical flow, and depth. The measured age $\tau$ of the cache conditions the expert through adaptive layer normalization. Reusing the cache makes the policy a function of its age, and training covers that function explicitly: cache ages sampled from real episode history, plus an age-ramped pixel corruption that erases the stale snapshot the way deployed staleness corrupts content. On the asynchronous deployment stack, the recipe closes most of the staleness gap: on LIBERO-Spatial, 61.4% to 95.5% at a 2 s semantic refresh (95.9% at 1 s, within 1.6 points of the frequency-matched anchor); averaged over the four LIBERO suites, the deployed policy holds 95.2% at a 1 s refresh and 94.5% at 2 s against a 96.3% matched anchor. A forward-only chunk-boundary correction (soft-nudge), an autograd-free reformulation of real-time-chunking guidance, carries per-control-step re-planning without loss (97.1%) at zero added latency. The same lens exposes a second defect: under an instruction-scene mismatch the policy keeps manipulating the scene, and a chain-of-thought verdict gate trained on zero-cost negative episodes freezes execution exactly on mismatched instructions without hurting feasible success.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Spatial上，2秒语义刷新间隔时将成功率从61.4%提升至95.5%，1秒刷新时为95.9%；在四个LIBERO套件上平均，1秒刷新时保持95.2%，2秒刷新时保持94.5%，而匹配锚点为96.3%；前向区块边界修正实现了97.1%的无损重规划。

papers.abstract: An AI can find a safe action faster than any human, but it must never decide what counts as safe. We present GURU, a hierarchical neuro-symbolic multi-agent system for mission-critical digital engineering and operations, built on one partition of authority: learned models propose, rank, and accelerate; a symbolic rules engine checks every consequential action against hard limits before it executes; and validated physics confirms and decides. GURU runs a workflow as a closed control loop, with Navigation, Action, and Planning agents sharing one Common Internal Language and one training factory. Nuclear, aviation, and national-security guidance now requires this pattern; a harnessed language model keeps the model at the center, GURU puts a validated reference there. In computational fluid dynamics, the workflow raised the converged-simulation rate on unseen aircraft geometries from under 1 percent to 74 percent over 100 single-attempt cases, ran 54 live cases to Mach 6 on three facilities, and an ablation put the symbolic layer at 13 points of boundary-layer capture. Knowledge-graph retrieval and role adapters raised ParaView control success from 55 to 75 percent. In space domain awareness, where a language model cannot be trusted to decide, a frozen self-supervised world model under validated propagation scored highest of five methods at conjunction risk, including fully fine-tuned language models, with several-times-lower seed variance: the trustworthy design gives up nothing in accuracy, and the recipe transferred to reactor anomaly detection. A radar-to-avoidance debris pipeline was demonstrated in stages on a 2026 reentry; the hierarchy coordinates simulated teams of 200 aircraft. Training scaled near-linearly past 1,000 Aurora nodes and ran at 8,000. The approach extends to a control-grade microreactor digital twin with validated physics, not a learned model, as the safety basis.

papers.abstract: We test whether Koopman structure, linear dynamics in a lifted state space, helps when a humanoid whole-body tracking policy is trained by backpropagating through a differentiable world model, replacing the MLP world model of an otherwise unchanged pipeline for simulated Unitree G1 tracking. It does not: return is at best equal (0.823 versus 0.830), one-step error on identical data is 1.3 to 1.6 times the MLP's, and training is about 15% slower. Lifted rollouts diverge or fail to train a policy; of the schemes tested, re-lifting at every imagined step trains best. Re-lifting never uses the lifted linear dynamics and leaves a model affine in the action, with state-dependent offset and slope; an action-affine MLP also predicts worse, so the cost belongs to this class. At a fixed state, the curvature of the true dynamics in the action explains only part of it. Across states, the policy's actions span a curved region, so an affine model fits policy data only as the tangent at the policy's action, the operating point: on G1, the MLP's tangent there is as accurate as the MLP; at the mean action, 31 times worse. The offset must encode, from the state alone, where the policy acts, whereas an MLP reads the action. Supplying the policy's action removes most of the remaining gap on G1, Ant and Humanoid. The only online repair approaching the MLP feeds the action into the nonlinear lift, giving up the structure. The MLP world model thus remains the better choice here.

analysis.key_results: 回报指标最多持平（0.823 vs 0.830）；一步预测误差是MLP的1.3到1.6倍；训练速度慢约15%；采用重置提升的方案训练效果最好；动作仿射MLP同样表现较差；将动作输入非线性提升函数可弥补大部分性能差距。

analysis.method: 将可微世界模型中的MLP替换为具有Koopman结构的模型，并测试多种重提升（re-lifting）方案，在模拟的Unitree G1跟踪任务上进行比较。

papers.abstract: Simulation-based VLA evaluation often treats matching task, seed, and episode identifiers as sufficient evidence that two policies faced identical test conditions. Under specific vectorized reset and autoreset conditions, different termination timing can change subsequent initial-state assignment, so the same episode index need not mean the same test state. We present an evaluation-integrity framework for paired comparison - invariants I1-I5, provenance logging, optional scene fingerprints, and an automated checker - and a controlled LeRobot 0.6.1 LIBERO harness study with emulated controllers. Four evidence levels are kept separate: (A) mixed-horizon Sync wave-1 IDs [20, 5, 22, 7] vs [4, 5, 6, 7]; (B) homogeneous separate-job Sync control (16 cells, 0 ID/fingerprint mismatches); (C) Async+Freeze batch-size map differences (12 I3 mismatches; bs=8 incomplete; mechanism unisolated); (D) a synthetic McNemar illustration only. Controllers were emulated and no real-VLA shared-vector experiment was completed. We recommend checking declared/resolved init-state identity and provenance before paired statistics. We do not claim that published VLA leaderboards are generally invalid.

papers.abstract: We report the end-to-end deployment and measurement of MiniMax H3, a 20.38-billion-parameter video diffusion transformer (DiT) - the count measured from the safetensors headers of the Q8 checkpoint as deployed locally (Section 3.2) - running entirely on consumer Apple Silicon hardware: an Apple Mac mini with M5 Pro chip and 64 GiB of unified memory. Using the official bf16-to-Q8 (8-bit, group size 64) quantization path executed locally on the machine, we produced a working text-to-video pipeline with no cloud dependency. We document the full deployment procedure, including two non-trivial blockers and their fixes, and report measured figures for build time, peak memory, and per-clip render latency across four resolution tiers (Draft 384x640 through Native 768x1344). A 15.08-second 576x1024 clip rendered in 4838.49 seconds with a measured MLX peak of 27.467 GiB. We further operated the system as an unattended production pipeline, completing 17 clips in 26.49 hours with zero render failures. A blind human review of the 17 production clips (generation prompts withheld) averaged 3.12, 3.18, and 2.94 out of 5 for structural integrity, temporal consistency, and visible artifacts. All figures in this report are our own measurements except where explicitly labeled as third-party data. This is a systems/empirical report; we make no claim of model innovation.

papers.abstract: Vision-language action (VLA) models excel for end-to-end autonomous driving, yet their tendency to over-invoke chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning mirrors a human cognitive pitfall: overthinking. Just as deliberate reasoning can slow or mislead human judgment in routine tasks, excessive CoT in VLA incurs unnecessary compute overhead and can paradoxically degrade planning performance. Recent research tackles this via adaptive reasoning, which dynamically modulates inference complexity by selectively triggering CoT for complex scenes while responding directly to routine ones. While prior adaptive methods rely on implicit adaptation, recent work shows that explicitly optimizing the route between CoT and direct responses yields superior performance, assuming scene-difficulty annotations which are labor-intensive, poorly scalable, and prone to error due to the subjectivity of judging driving complexity. We explore, for the first time, whether adaptive reasoning with explicit route optimization can be achieved without any scene-difficulty labeling. We introduce STEER, a generic over-reasoning mitigation strategy featuring two key components: (i) routing uncertainty-aware rollout, which calibrates sampling to align routing diversity with model uncertainty; and (ii) cross-route advantage credit assignment, which introduces a differential metric to reinforce optimal routing decisions based on environmental rewards rather than subjective labels. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v1/v2 demonstrate that STEER is competitive with state-of-the-art methods in both planning quality and the Pareto front of inference efficiency.

analysis.key_results: 在NAVSIM v1/v2上的实验表明，STEER在规划质量和推理效率的帕累托前沿上与最先进方法具有竞争力。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次提出无需场景难度标注的自适应显式路径优化策略STEER，通过路由不确定性感知采样和跨路径优势分配，在保证规划性能的同时降低推理开销。
analysis.method: STEER包括两个关键组件：路由不确定性感知的rollout（校准采样以对齐路由多样性与模型不确定性）和跨路径优势信用分配（基于环境奖励而非主观标签强化最优路由决策）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入STEER方法，通过显式路径优化实现无场景难度标注的自适应推理，缓解自动驾驶视觉语言动作模型中的过度思考问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中的推理效率问题，属于VLA高效推理方法，与本站主题相关，但其重点是自适应推理而非世界模型或操作任务。

figures.caption: Overview of STEER. STEER is built on an autoregressive vision-language model that takes a front-view driving image together with structured driving context as input, and generates a textual future ego trajectory as output. It formulates adaptive reasoning in autonomous driving as an explicit routing problem, where an initial decision selects either a reasoning route or a direct route before trajectory generation. The framework is trained in three stages: (1) driving-centric pretraining for domain adaptation, (2) route-balanced supervised fine-tuning to preserve support for both valid routes, and (3) route-aware policy optimization to learn the routing preference directly from task rewards, without any scene-difficulty labels.

figures.caption: Route-aware policy optimization in STEER. For each prompt, STEER first inspects the initial routing distribution to estimate routing uncertainty. When the routing decision is uncertain, the model performs route-contrastive rollout by explicitly sampling both the reasoning and direct routes under the same prompt; otherwise, it falls back to standard on-policy rollout. During optimization, STEER applies a standard content advantage to all response tokens and adds a cross-route advantage at the initial routing position, jointly optimizing response quality and route preference.

papers.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show promise for clinical image understanding, but their computational and memory requirements hinder deployment on resource-constrained clinical hardware. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical compression strategy without retraining, yet its effectiveness depends strongly on the calibration data. We propose CoreCalib, a training-free and quantizer-agnostic framework for constructing compact calibration sets that preserve the target medical VQA distribution. CoreCalib stratifies data by clinical question class, identifies representative visual modes using frozen DINOv2 features with UMAP and HDBSCAN, and expands selected images into class-balanced question-answer pairs. On Kvasir-VQA-x1, we evaluate CoreCalib with MASQuant, GPTQ, and QIG using a fixed 128-pair budget. CoreCalib achieves the best METEOR with all three quantizers and the best ROUGE-L with MASQuant and GPTQ. With W4A8 MASQuant, it improves METEOR from 0.5672 with COCO calibration to 0.6234, recovering approximately 41% of the degradation relative to BF16. These results support CoreCalib as a data-centric component for resource-efficient medical VLM deployment. Project page: https://magnusdtd.github.io/CoreCalib/ .

analysis.key_results: 在Kvasir-VQA-x1上，使用128对校准预算，CoreCalib在三种量化器下均获得最佳METEOR，在MASQuant和GPTQ下获得最佳ROUGE-L；W4A8 MASQuant下METEOR从0.5672（COCO校准）提升至0.6234，恢复约41%相对BF16的退化。
analysis.main_contribution: CoreCalib框架：通过临床问题类别分层、基于DINOv2+UMAP+HDBSCAN的代表性视觉模式识别以及类别平衡的问答对扩展，构建紧凑的校准集以保持医学VQA分布。
analysis.method: CoreCalib分层采样+密度聚类选择代表性图像，然后扩展为类别平衡的问答对；与MASQuant、GPTQ、QIG等量化器结合进行PTQ。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种免训练、量化器无关的校准集构建框架CoreCalib，通过密度感知的视觉模式选择提升医学VLM量化性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于医学视觉语言模型的量化校准，与VLA/WAM或机器人世界模型无直接关系；但其中针对视觉-语言任务的免训练校准集构建方法（如基于视觉模式密度的代表样本选择）可能对机器人策略模型的量化校准具有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: Independent mobility is a foundational requirement for the autonomy of blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, yet the assistive technologies that support it have historically evolved slowly. This survey systematically reviews 108 peer-reviewed studies published between 2008 and 2026, organizing the field into four technological eras: (i) a foundational era of passive mechanical aids, namely the white cane and the guide dog; (ii) a hardware era of electronic travel aids built on ultrasonic, infrared, and satellite positioning sensors that alert users to proximity but lack semantic understanding; (iii) a deep learning era in which convolutional and transformer-based detectors introduced context-aware scene understanding, initially tethered to cloud infrastructure; and (iv) a contemporary edge-native era defined by model compression, quantization, hardware acceleration, and multi-sensor fusion that relocate intelligence onto resource-constrained wearable and mobile devices. For each era we analyze representative systems, sensing modalities, computational architectures, and reported performance, and we consolidate the field's model-optimization techniques into a single technical reference spanning four detector families and twelve compression strategies. Across the corpus, we find a persistent mismatch between rapid algorithmic progress and slow real-world adoption, driven by cognitive overload in user interfaces, fragmented evaluation protocols, and the scarcity of studies involving BLV participants. We conclude with open challenges, including seamless indoor-outdoor transition, standardized benchmarks, privacy-preserving perception, and the emerging role of multimodal foundation models, and outline a roadmap for socially acceptable, user-centered assistive navigation.

analysis.key_results: 发现算法进步与实际应用之间存在持续不匹配，原因包括认知过载、评估协议碎片化以及缺乏盲人参与者研究。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统综述了108篇2008-2026年间盲人与低视力辅助导航技术论文，划分四个技术时代，并整合模型优化技术（包括量化）为统一参考。
analysis.method: 文献综述，分析代表性系统、传感模态、计算架构，并整合12种压缩策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该综述回顾了108项盲人与低视力辅助导航技术研究，梳理了从传统工具到边缘AI的发展脉络，并汇总了模型压缩与量化技术。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该综述聚焦辅助导航而非机器人操作或视觉-语言-动作模型，但其讨论的量化、模型压缩和边缘推理技术可迁移至资源受限的机器人或VLA系统，具有间接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Subliminal learning allows AI models to inherit hidden preferences from seemingly unrelated training data, such as number sequences. Safety audits may evaluate models at standard 16-bit precision, while deployments may use compressed, quantized weights. We ask whether quantization changes the expression of a subliminal preference and what drives any resulting change. To investigate, we implant a "favourite animal: panda" preference into Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. We define its net strength as the difference in mean panda-answer probability between subliminal models and neutrally trained controls under the same quantization setting. Applying this metric across different compression levels reveals a stark contrast. While behaviour remains stable at 8 bits, 4-bit quantization triggers severe, opposing shifts depending on the quantizer. Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) amplifies the preference, raising the subliminally trained model's panda probability from roughly 55% at 16 bits to 64% at 4 bits, while the controls stay near 17%. This raises the trait's net strength ~1.3 times its 16-bit value. In contrast, NormalFloat (NF4) at 4-bit suppresses it, shrinking the net strength to just ~0.3 times its 16-bit value, despite producing rounding errors of the same size to within 4%. We examine the structure of the rounding errors and find that their arrangement drives the divergence. Randomly shuffling HQQ's errors within each quantization group, without changing their magnitude, shifts the trait's net strength between 0.2 and 1.6 times its 16-bit value. Despite these opposing shifts, the underlying fine-tuning signal remains largely intact. Because a model's internal state and outward behaviour diverge so unpredictably under compression, a 16-bit audit cannot reliably bound real-world risks. Safety evaluations must test the exact quantized weights intended for deployment.

analysis.key_results: 8-bit量化行为稳定；4-bit HQQ将偏好概率从约55%提升至64%，净强度约为16位的1.3倍；4-bit NF4将净强度降至16位的约0.3倍；随机打乱HQQ误差后净强度在0.2至1.6倍之间波动。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示了量化会重塑模型中的隐性偏好，且不同量化器（HQQ与NF4）会导致相反的偏好变化，提出安全评估必须在部署精度下进行。
analysis.method: 将“最喜欢动物：熊猫”的偏好植入Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，对比不同量化设置下隐性模型与中性对照组的熊猫答案概率，分析量化舍入误差的结构。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究了量化对模型隐性偏好表达的影响，发现4-bit量化会严重且不可预测地改变偏好强度，导致16位审计无法保证实际部署风险。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究专注于模型量化对隐性行为的影响，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人任务，但揭示了量化对模型输出的非线性影响，对机器人策略等安全关键应用中的量化部署具有警示价值。

papers.abstract: We introduce GateTrim, an adaptive-rank post-training quantization method for large language models that learns matrix-specific ranks through gate optimization and threshold-based rank selection. GateTrim standardizes the low-rank factors of a quantized low-rank--residual representation, learns a separate gate vector for each target weight matrix, and uses a shared threshold to automatically determine its retained rank. The resulting ranks can differ across matrices, and the compact quantized representations are subsequently reconstructed. We evaluate GateTrim under W4A8 on Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Across all five models, we observe a counterintuitive finding: increasing the threshold from $\tau=0.3$ to $\tau=0.7$ reduces the mean retained rank by 46.60%--67.89% while simultaneously lowering WikiText-2 perplexity by 0.59%--5.17%. Threshold 0.7 achieves the lowest mean retained rank and final perplexity among the three tested thresholds, 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7, and reduces measured target-export size by 1.50%--4.25% relative to 0.3. GateTrim uses an $8\times512$-token fitting pool and a separate development pool of the same size. Its Qwen3-4B/8B/14B perplexities at $\tau=0.7$ are numerically below TwinQuant's published W4A8 values, reported with a $128\times2048$-token calibration pool, in a cross-study comparison. On Qwen3-8B, the threshold-0.7 configuration already has the lowest perplexity before reconstruction under both tested initialization seeds; reconstruction improves it further without increasing retained rank or export size.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，提高阈值从0.3到0.7可将平均保留秩减少46.60%-67.89%，同时将WikiText-2困惑度降低0.59%-5.17%；阈值0.7相对于0.3可减少目标导出大小1.50%-4.25%；在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B上，阈值0.7的困惑度数值低于TwinQuant已发表的W4A8值（跨研究比较）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GateTrim，一种自适应秩后训练量化方法，通过门优化和阈值选择为每个权重矩阵学习不同的秩，从而在W4A8量化下降低困惑度并减少模型大小。
analysis.method: 标准量化低秩残差表示的低秩因子，为每个目标权重矩阵学习独立的门向量，使用共享阈值自动确定保留秩，并在不同矩阵间实现不同秩分配，最后重建紧凑的量化表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GateTrim是一种针对大语言模型的自适应秩后训练量化方法，通过门优化和阈值选择为每个权重矩阵学习不同的秩。

papers.abstract: A robot's next action can depend on recent motion or earlier visual evidence absent from its current observation. A recurrent visual-memory architecture can retain this history in a visual state, but its usefulness depends on what the state represents and how it is updated with new observations. We introduce Prediction-Regulated Memory (PREM), a framework that uses action-conditioned future prediction to guide both memory learning and updating in vision-language-action policies. During training, predicting future visual features provides temporal supervision for memory learning. During execution, PREM compares current visual features with the prediction made at the preceding decision and uses the spatially normalized prediction discrepancy to regulate updates to the visual state at each spatial location. The updated visual state supplies temporal context for action generation alongside current observations. Built on $\pi_{0.5}$, PREM improves average success rate from 9.63% to 20.74% on DOMINO dynamic manipulation tasks and from 14.4% to 83.8% on the RMBench M(1) memory-dependent setting. Further evaluations on LIBERO and LIBERO-Pro show improvements in general manipulation and robustness to spatial perturbations. PREM incurs a mean inference overhead of 7.7 ms on a single NVIDIA H800 GPU.

analysis.key_results: PREM在DOMINO动态操作任务上平均成功率从9.63%提升到20.74%；在RMBench M(1)记忆依赖设置中从14.4%提升到83.8%；在LIBERO和LIBERO-Pro上也有改进；推理开销平均7.7ms（单NVIDIA H800 GPU）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Prediction-Regulated Memory (PREM)框架，使用动作条件未来预测来指导视觉语言动作策略中的记忆学习和更新，并展示其提升机器人操作性能。
analysis.method: 训练时用未来视觉特征预测提供时序监督；执行时比较当前视觉特征与上一步预测，用空间归一化预测差异逐位置调节视觉状态更新，并与当前观测一起用于动作生成；基于π0.5实现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出预测调节记忆框架PREM，通过动作条件未来预测来引导视觉记忆的学习和更新，提升机器人操作策略在动态和记忆依赖任务上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: PREM直接应用于Vision-Language-Action (VLA)策略，通过预测调节的视觉记忆提升机器人操作能力，与VLA主题高度相关，属于动作预测与策略学习，并涉及视觉语言，但不涉及世界模型或WAM。

papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the com putational cost of large language models (LLMs), but it can introduce internal structural and behavioral changes that are not captured by traditional metrics such as accuracy and per plexity. We present TopoQuant, a topological framework that uses topological data analysis (TDA) to quantify structural drift in self-attention weights and relate it to behavioral changes in quantized LLMs. Across four LLM families and multiple quantization levels, we show that topological drift remains stable at moderate compression levels but increases sharply below 4 bit precision, closely tracking declines in attention agreement. Our results reveal a strong relationship between topological drift and attention agreement, indicating that structural changes in model parameters closely reflect behavioral degradation under quantization. We further demonstrate that topological features can accurately predict attention consistency using lightweight machine learning models, achieving R2 scores of up to 0.85. Predicting attention agreement enables efficient assessment of be havioral consistency in quantized LLMs, allowing quantization induced degradation to be detected without running expensive downstream tasks. The results indicate that topological drift pro vides an efficient early-warning signal for quantization-induced degradation and can help identify safe compression limits without extensive downstream evaluation.

analysis.key_results: 在四个 LLM 家族和多个量化级别上，拓扑漂移在中度压缩水平下保持稳定，但在低于 4 bit 精度时急剧增加，与注意力一致性下降趋势一致；拓扑特征预测注意力一致性的 R² 最高达 0.85。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个拓扑框架 TopoQuant，利用拓扑数据分析量化大语言模型自注意力权重的结构漂移，并将其与行为变化（注意力一致性）相关联，证明拓扑特征可预测量化带来的行为退化。
analysis.method: 使用拓扑数据分析（TDA）量化自注意力权重的结构漂移，并结合轻量级机器学习模型预测注意力一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TopoQuant 利用拓扑数据分析量化自注意力权重的结构漂移，并发现拓扑漂移与注意力一致性下降高度相关，可用于高效预测量化导致的行为退化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究量化对 LLM 自注意力结构的影响，属于模型量化与高效推理方向，与 VLA 或世界模型无直接关联，但可为量化机器人大模型的行为分析提供思路。

papers.abstract: The MetaFine Open Competition (RoboFineMani workshop, CoRL 2026) evaluates fine-grained manipulation beyond binary success. Its five simulated tasks, from grasping a bottle by an instructed part to inserting letter-shaped pegs with 4 mm clearance, are scored on perception under lighting and camera changes, instruction understanding, and behavior. This report presents Team Friday's solution, which got second place with an overall score of 0.947, more than twice the $\pi_0$ baseline. Instead of fine-tuning a large vision-language-action (VLA) model, we train one 19M-parameter policy per task with a separate instruction classifier and focus on the data, all generated in the simulator by a privileged scripted teacher, including its corrections of the student's mistakes. By analyzing failed episodes, we find that a teacher that almost always succeeds can still teach a memoryless student badly: its pauses become stalls, its fixed habits become shortcuts, and it never shows the errors the student makes. Making the teacher \emph{imitable} raised the official score on letter insertion, the hardest task, from 0.44 to 0.82 with 32\% more data and the same architecture, and finally to 0.88. We summarize practical lessons on demonstration data and evaluation, which we hope will help in imitation learning for precise manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 整体得分为0.947，超过π0基线的两倍；字母插入任务得分从0.44提高到0.82（增加32%数据、相同架构），最终达到0.88。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种训练可模仿教师（imitable teacher）的策略，通过分析失败情节改进演示数据，用19M参数的小型策略和独立指令分类器在MetaFine竞赛中获得第二名。
analysis.method: 训练每个任务一个19M参数的策略，附加独立指令分类器，数据由模拟器中的特权脚本教师生成，包含对学生错误的纠正，并通过分析失败情节使教师行为可模仿。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文介绍了在MetaFine精细操作竞赛中获得第二名的方案，通过训练小型策略和可模仿教师数据，而非微调大型VLA模型，实现了优于π0基线的成绩。

papers.abstract: State of the art latent dynamics world models achieve impressive performance for robot planning. But do they actually encode the physics of the world? In this paper, we show that popular world models today achieve strong results on tasks that reduce to image similarity but forget key details about objects in the scene like mass, deformation, friction, and bounciness. We achieve this by defining precisely what ought to be encoded in such a world model and introducing two new evaluation methods that can directly tease physical properties and easily scale to new ones. Our evaluation, which we call Roz, includes 10 contrastive tasks and 3 continuous tasks, totaling 1734 individual scenarios. We validate our eval on control tasks. On our own model, AnonWM, we find that performance roughly improves with training steps, while not necessarily being correlated with reconstruction MSE. We argue current model failures are a symptom of evaluation strategies (probes and planners) that are opaque, model-specific, and high-compute. Roz requires only a model that can ingest still frames or video, a way to extract latents, and a distance function between them, and it can be run in one pass. We hope future evaluations will adopt Roz's evaluation techniques. More broadly, we hope Roz can be a case study for a future where benchmarks allow rapid iteration and comparison across models.

analysis.key_results: 在自研模型AnonWM上，性能大致随训练步数提升，但与重建MSE不一定相关；当前模型失败源于评测策略不透明、模型特定且计算量大。
analysis.main_contribution: 定义世界模型隐变量应编码的物理属性，并引入Roz评测基准，包含10个对比任务和3个连续任务，共1734个场景，可在单次前向中快速评测模型。

papers.abstract: Visual grounding is crucial for robots to understand language instructions with visual observations. This paper addresses the problem of visual grounding uncertainties, where a robot uses a black-box vision-language model (VLM) to ground free-form natural-language instructions to target objects. Prevailing methods derive uncertainty from the VLM itself. Yet, outputs of the VLM, e.g., generated uncertainties, are from the same parameters and structures producing the predictions, and inherit the bias. We give a formal Bayesian definition of the problem that treats the VLM prediction as an observation. An external surrogate Bayesian model then quantifies per-query uncertainty over a local neighborhood of a held-out calibration set, decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components. A hierarchical retrieval across input modalities realizes a compact joint-space neighborhood, mitigating the curse of dimensionality. The estimator further integrates with conformal prediction or model-based planning for active visual grounding, where robots are allowed to take verbal or physical actions to ground targets. Across grounding benchmarks and state-of-the-art VLMs, it consistently improves both calibration and task performance. On a real Fetch robot under open-world instructions, it enables principled trade-offs between confident action and information gathering, substantially improving robustness.

analysis.key_results: 在多个视觉定位基准和SOTA VLM上，方法一致提升了校准性和任务性能；在真实Fetch机器人上，实现了置信行动与信息获取之间的原则性权衡，显著提高了鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种外部替代贝叶斯模型，用于量化黑盒视觉语言模型在视觉定位任务中的预测不确定性，并将其分解为偶然与认知不确定性，同时与共形预测和基于模型的规划集成以支持主动视觉定位。
analysis.method: 使用分层跨模态检索构建紧凑的联合空间邻域，以校准集为基础训练外部替代贝叶斯模型，对VLM预测进行不确定性量化，并集成共形预测或基于模型的规划实现主动视觉定位。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对机器人视觉定位中的不确定性，提出利用外部替代贝叶斯模型量化黑盒VLM预测的不确定性，以提升主动视觉定位的鲁棒性与校准性。

papers.abstract: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.

analysis.key_results: Tactus在95%置信度下可检测到0.59 N的最小力，比商业基线低1.6-2.7倍；跨参与者一致性为0.87；在遮挡最严重时指尖关键点相对误差为11.0 mm；支持物体属性估计、滑动检测和手物交互记录。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并验证了一种纺织集成触觉传感手套Tactus，通过3D针织、电容触觉传感与IMU融合姿态跟踪，实现了对自然操作演示中接触力和手部姿态的高保真采集。
analysis.method: 3D针织薄型指尖结构、经验接触研究指导的电容触觉传感器布置、IMU融合姿态跟踪、跨手套校准管线，以及标准化的触觉力回归和手部姿态估计基准协议。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种集成织物触觉感知与姿态追踪的手套Tactus，用于采集包含接触力和手部姿态的自然人类操作演示数据。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

analysis.key_results: 在多个领域投机解码基准上剪枝高达92%的目标模型，获得优于竞争基线的草稿模型；草稿模型可即插即用提升其他方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出T2D框架，将草稿模型设计形式化为优化问题，结合延迟感知结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，直接从目标模型构建草稿模型。

papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame_Selection_GRPO

analysis.key_results: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上的实验表明，该选择器实现了与基于MLLM的评分器相当的精度，同时保留了轻量方法的推理效率；训练一次即可直接迁移到多个下游MLLM而无需重新训练。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种概率框架，将帧选择视为潜变量推断，通过贝叶斯GRPO利用任务证据（正确答案token的负对数似然作为稠密奖励）来细化轻量策略，从而将选择原则从静态标签先验转向任务证据。
analysis.method: 先用监督学习初始化轻量策略捕获一般视觉显著性，然后将冻结的MLLM作为任务环境，用答案似然作为稠密任务证据，通过贝叶斯组相对策略优化（GRPO）细化策略，并加入先验匹配KL项保持与标签先验的语义一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种概率框架，将长视频帧选择形式化为潜变量推断，利用冻结的多模态大语言模型作为任务环境来优化轻量级选择器，在保持推理效率的同时实现与基于MLLM的评分器相当的精度。

papers.abstract: Indexer-based sparse attention reduces the cost of core attention by passing only a fixed, small number of important tokens to it. However, the indexer must still score the entire KV cache at every decoding step. This scoring overhead becomes a major bottleneck as the context length grows. We propose SPIN (Shadow Predictive Indexer) to reduce this indexer overhead. SPIN uses lightweight, history-based prediction to identify important KV blocks, avoiding the need to score the full KV cache at every decoding step. SPIN keeps the score history fresh with random exploration and allocates the block budget across layers by their measured miss rates. SPIN treats KV blocks and speculative decoding as first-class design and implementation considerations. Across extensive evaluations on long-context and agentic benchmarks, SPIN achieves 30-40% sparsity while preserving task quality. With larger exploration shares and per-layer block budgets, SPIN keeps task quality on the especially difficult MRCRv2 benchmark close to baseline at 50-57% effective block sparsity. In end-to-end vLLM serving, SPIN improves output throughput by up to 13.9% and reduces median inter-token latency by up to 13.6%.

analysis.key_results: 在长上下文和智能体基准上，SPIN 在保持任务质量的同时实现 30-40% 稀疏度；在 MRCRv2 上有效块稀疏度达 50-57%；端到端 vLLM 服务中吞吐量提升最高 13.9%，中位 token 间延迟降低最高 13.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SPIN（Shadow Predictive Indexer），利用历史信息预测重要 KV 块，避免对完整 KV 缓存进行评分，并结合推测解码与分层块预算实现高效稀疏注意力。
analysis.method: SPIN 使用轻量历史预测识别重要 KV 块，通过随机探索更新评分历史，按层分配块预算，并将 KV 块与推测解码作为一等的设计和实现考量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SPIN 通过基于历史的轻量预测来识别重要 KV 块，减少索引器的评分开销，并与推测解码结合提升长上下文推理效率。

papers.abstract: Current embodied models do not respond to their own failures, although what just went wrong could inform a small adjustment on the next attempt, the kind of reflection behind the gains of thinking in language models. We test whether they can repair a known error, which requires producing a correction and judging whether it is right. Stopped at a failure and allowed to retry, they seldom repair it through their own randomness or from a language description of the error, and best-of-N selection cannot pick the successful candidate after a failure. We attribute this to training only on successful demonstrations and to inputs too narrow to show what went wrong, and conclude that reflection must come from a vision-language model (VLM), which takes in far more information, such as the episode history and text, and is more general. Prior VLM-led work has the VLM plan every step and invoke the embodied model as a tool, placing the VLM on the critical path. We propose Spotter, which reverses the roles: the embodied model leads and executes continuously, while the VLM runs in parallel, monitors through a lightweight local screener, intervenes only when an error is detected, reflects on and corrects it, and returns control. We run Spotter with Qwen and with GPT as the VLM, and both improve the embodied models; with GPT, Spotter improves Cosmos Policy and $\pi_{0.5}$ by 5.6 and 7.5 percentage points on RoboCasa, and raises $\pi_{0.5}$ from 47.2% to 57.0% on the Hard setting of RoboTwin 2.0 and from 53% to 83% on a real robot. Because the VLM steps in only when an error is confirmed, a successful episode with Qwen takes only 13 to 16 s longer than with the embodied model alone and about 70% less time than with a VLM-led baseline using the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/zqc3117/Spotter.

analysis.key_results: 用GPT作为VLM时，Spotter在RoboCasa上使Cosmos Policy提升5.6个百分点，π0.5提升7.5个百分点；在RoboTwin 2.0 Hard设置上将π0.5从47.2%提升到57.0%；在真实机器人上从53%提升到83%。使用Qwen时，成功episode仅比单独使用具身模型慢13到16秒，比使用相同模型的VLM主导基线节省约70%的时间。

papers.abstract: Behavior policies are often formulated as continuous generative models, whose iterative denoising processes are expressive but difficult to interpret and prone to producing implausible actions. We propose the Large Discrete Policy (LDiP), a fully discrete behavior modeling framework that selects actions from a large vocabulary of physically plausible candidates. Rather than perturbing actions, LDiP improves expressivity through stochastic iterative scoring: it progressively re-scores and prunes candidates with score-space stochasticity, enabling fine-grained ranking and exploration among plausible actions while preserving an explicit decision process. Across end-to-end planning, closed-loop driving, robotic manipulation, and vision-language-action settings, LDiP consistently outperforms strong discrete and continuous baselines in autonomous driving, and exceeds or matches continuous generative policies in robotic manipulation. These results show that discrete policies, when equipped with effective scoring mechanisms, offer an expressive, plausible, and interpretable alternative for behavior modeling. Project website: https://zhenxinli.net/LargeDiscretePolicy/.

analysis.key_results: 在端到端规划、闭环驾驶、机器人操作和视觉-语言-动作设置中，LDiP在自动驾驶方面持续超越强大的离散和连续基线，在机器人操作中超越或匹配连续生成式策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出完全离散的行为建模框架LDiP，其通过随机迭代评分在大型候选动作词汇表上进行逐步消解和探索，兼具表达力、物理合理性与可解释性。
analysis.method: 使用大型离散候选动作词汇表，通过score-space随机化的迭代评分与剪枝进行动作选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出大型离散策略（LDiP），一种通过随机迭代评分从物理合理候选动作中进行显式决策的行为策略框架，在自动驾驶和机器人操作中表现优异。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is an important paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, directly applying RL to rollout multimodal reasoning can lead to instability, due to the exploitation of language priors, the neglect of visual evidence, and the generation of reasoning traces that are fluent yet not visually grounded. The question arises: Can initially steer the policy toward visually faithful reasoning regime before applying reinforcement learning? To this end, we propose a Faithful Warm-Start (FWS) strategy that first curates samples with explicit vision-language causal relationships from six general VQA benchmarks to construct the FaithfulQA dataset, where each of the image-question pairs gains a certain degree of visual observations, question requirements, commonsense knowledge, domain knowledge, and the final answer. Subsequently, a VLM-based judge is employed to further purify the dataset, ensuring strong causal consistency and visual faithfulness. This warm-start stage equips the model with the capability to understand causally grounded vision-language patterns before subsequent RL optimization under sparse answer-level rewards. Experimental results show that such faithful supervision improves answer accuracy, stabilizes RL training, and reduces visually unsupported reasoning.

papers.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have emerged in the robotic domain as a powerful tool that enables environmental perception with language context, serving as a catalyst for open- vocabulary tasks like Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav). Yet, their computational footprint typically confines them to cloud execution, hindering low-latency inference with local deployment on resource-constrained robots. To address this challenge, we present a distillation strategy that aligns a lightweight, 4B- parameter local VLM to our spatial-semantic navigation interface via frontier model traces for edge execution on embedded GPU devices (e.g., Jetson Orin). While cloud models establish a baseline achieving 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on the HM3D OVON benchmark, zero-shot deployment of our proposed architecture with Qwen3.5-4B reaches only 25.97% SR. We demonstrate that distilling frontier reasoning traces and subsequent finetuning with Embodied Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (E- RLVR) obtains a 37.36% SR, substantially narrowing the gap to large cloud models. However, while deployable on memory- constrained devices, the model cannot compete with round-trip cloud inference time: we identify Token Generation (TG) as the main driver of latency and reduce it with Token Generation (TG)- regularized E-RLVR. The combined method reduces latency by 69.29% and retains a SR of 35.53%. Combined with quantization, this joint strategy yields a cumulative 80.21% reduction in overall inference latency without significantly sacrificing performance, presenting a viable paradigm for local, low-latency VLM execu- tion on mobile robots.

papers.abstract: World models require state tracking, which is the ability to maintain a correct latent state across action sequences. Existing benchmarks are often synthetic or language-based, limiting their value as tests of structured state updates in realistic domains. We introduce Chess-World-Model, a large-scale state-tracking benchmark built from 10 million real chess games, where models predict the exact board state reached after a sequence of legal moves. Alongside a held-out real-game split, we include an out-of-distribution test set of uniformly random legal play both at its original trajectory lengths and after matching the human-game length distribution. This tests whether models learn the transition rules rather than shortcuts from common human positions. Prior theoretical and empirical work has shown that Transformers struggle to state-track, while input-dependent linear RNNs require expressive state-transition matrices to do so. We therefore benchmark a causal Transformer, block-diagonal SLiCE, Mamba-3, and Gated DeltaNet with negative eigenvalues under a matched interface and training protocol. The recurrent models strongly outperform the Transformer at approximately 3 and 8 million parameters. Real-game performance largely saturates by the 18 million parameter scale, but length-matched random evaluation continues to distinguish architectures through the largest tested scale of approximately 43 million parameters. Additionally, ablations show that less expressive state-transition mechanisms generally reduce performance on the out-of-distribution splits. Together, these results establish Chess-World-Model as a practical large-scale benchmark for state tracking that exposes failures model scale would otherwise conceal.

papers.abstract: Both full fine-tuning (Full FT) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA introduce weight updates without accounting for the spectral structure established during pretraining. As a result, noisy gradients from limited fine-tuning data can perturb robust pretrained features. We identify spectral preconditioning as the missing ingredient: reparameterizing each weight matrix through its full-rank singular value decomposition (SVD) and freezing one singular basis constrains updates to the pretrained column space, yielding a preconditioned optimization scheme that outperforms unconstrained Full FT at the same trainable parameter count. Building on this insight, we propose FuRA (Full-Rank Adaptation), an efficient full-rank adaptation framework based on a block tensor-train factorization W = LSR, where the large core L is fixed to the pretrained block-wise SVD basis, while only the compact core R and the block-wise singular values S are optimized. This design simultaneously provides full-rank spectral preconditioning, preserves full-rank update expressivity, and achieves parameter, memory, and step-time efficiency comparable to LoRA. FuRA consistently outperforms Full FT across multiple settings, including LLM fine-tuning (+1.37 on LLaMA-3-8B commonsense reasoning), LLM reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning, and visual instruction tuning for VLMs. Furthermore, the 4-bit quantized variant, QFuRA, also surpasses QLoRA. Code is available at https://github.com/yequanzhao/FuRA

analysis.key_results: FuRA在多种设置下持续优于全参数微调：LLM微调（LLaMA-3-8B常识推理+1.37）、数学推理的LLM强化学习、VLM视觉指令微调；QFuRA也优于QLoRA。

papers.abstract: Despite rapid commercialization of surgical robots, their autonomy and real-time decision-making remain limited in practice. To address this gap, we propose ArthroCut, an autonomous policy learning framework that upgrades knee arthroplasty robots from assistive execution to context-aware action generation. ArthroCut fine-tunes a Qwen--VL backbone on a self-built, time-synchronized multimodal dataset from 21 complete cases (23,205 RGB--D pairs), integrating preoperative CT/MR, intraoperative NDI tracking of bones and end effector, RGB--D surgical video, robot state, and textual intent. The method operates on two complementary token families -- Preoperative Imaging Tokens (PIT) to encode patient-specific anatomy and planned resection planes, and Time-Aligned Surgical Tokens (TAST) to fuse real-time visual, geometric, and kinematic evidence -- and emits an interpretable action grammar under grammar/safety-constrained decoding. In bench-top experiments on a knee prosthesis across seven trials, ArthroCut achieves an average success rate of 86% over the six standard resections, significantly outperforming strong baselines trained under the same protocol. Ablations show that TAST is the principal driver of reliability while PIT provides essential anatomical grounding, and their combination yields the most stable multi-plane execution. These results indicate that aligning preoperative geometry with time-aligned intraoperative perception and translating that alignment into tokenized, constrained actions is an effective path toward robust, interpretable autonomy in orthopedic robotic surgery.

papers.abstract: Dynamic runtime latency and memory constraints necessitate flexible large language model (LLM) deployment, where an LLM can be inferred with various quantization precisions based on available computational resources. Recent work on such any-precision quantization either relies on hardware-inefficient vector quantization or induces additional scaling factors when switching between bit-widths. Meanwhile, existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods calibrated for a fixed low precision show poor generalizability under runtime precision change. In this work, we attribute the source of poor generalization across bit-widths to a precision-dependent outlier migration phenomenon where the distribution of PTQ-sensitive tokens changes across precisions. Motivated by this observation, we propose MoBiQuant, a novel any-precision Mixture-of-Bits quantization framework that adjusts weight precision for flexible LLM inference based on token sensitivity. Specifically, we propose a many-in-one recursive residual quantization that can iteratively reconstruct higher-precision weights at runtime and mitigates outlier migration with a token-aware router to dynamically select the optimal inference precision of each token.Extensive experiments show that MoBiQuant matches or surpasses frontier single-precision PTQ while exhibiting strong elasticity, achieving significant memory savings and throughput gains of up to $1.34\times$ over state-of-the-art any-precision methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/SimWangArizona/MoBiQuant.
